summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to amend its at-the-market (ATM) issuance program. The filing discloses that from December 19, 2025 to May 27, 2026, the company sold 137,623,885 common shares for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $24.7 million. On May 27, 2026, the company notified the sales agent of termination of the Sales Agreement, effective June 8, 2026, and suspended all future offers and sales until termination. This filing is a routine shelf takedown update and termination notice, not a special situation.
